title: Someone's Coming Home
setup: The human acknowledgment leaks. Some residents expect rescue, others expect cages, and Barkington markets himself as the only qualified negotiator.
escalation: Byte verifies that the signal is genuine but cannot verify the humans' intentions. NIP7 refuses to publish guesses as fact. Trixie wants to jam the sky; Neon explains that blocking the message would not stop a vessel already traveling.
resolution: The public council adopts a practical arrival plan: protect food reserves, establish one public communications channel and elect a delegation. The crew keeps the beacon for observation with transmission disabled pending a vote.
continuity: Arrival is approaching but no exact date is invented without evidence. The isolated AI can interpret protocol but cannot issue commands.
comedy: The city forms six committees to decide whether humans prefer being called humans.
ending_hook: Barkington starts assembling a private offer of city assets to the visitors.
status: Development draft — not scripted or recorded
